provenance_semantics.empirical: No new laboratory measurements in inherited phases.

entry.title: All frozen controls are sign-blind; one switched triangle protocol is informative
entry.scope: For the three-state row generator Q_F, singleton sensor, common stationary preparation, and additive uniform-reversible edge channel. Every frozen full-path law agrees between F and -F; exact switched endpoint contrast is nonzero locally.
entry.novelty_status: Specific conjunction priority unresolved; singleton renewal reversibility is established.

entry.title: Protocol-order mixed derivative measures one stationary edge current
entry.scope: Common pi, pi-reversible L, same durations. Mixed derivative equals -eta L_ji J_ij for a single controlled edge. A control changing pi can produce a false current interpretation.
entry.novelty_status: Elementary commutator response identity; no claim to invent kinetic response theory.

entry.title: Triangle full-path information and adaptive amplitude-budget bound
entry.scope: Fixed positive stage durations, compact positive-rate neighborhood, independent stationary records, and history-adaptive amplitudes between records. KL Theta(F^2 eta^2); transcript KL <= K F^2 E sum eta_i^2.
entry.novelty_status: Scoped proof; not an unrestricted control optimum or energy law.

entry.title: Sharp discrimination order under specified intervention or drive-energy constraints
entry.scope: Known equally likely triangle orientations; fixed stage durations, independent stationary preparations, and amplitudes chosen between records. D=Theta(min(1,|F|sqrt(min(B,M eta0^2)))). Energy translation fixes a deterministic record count before acquisition. Expected amplitude constraints apply under both hypotheses; terminal testing unrestricted.
entry.novelty_status: General decision theory and statistical methods are established; model-specific derivation internally reviewed. No unrestricted or total-apparatus-energy optimum.

entry.title: Exact randomized protocol-order composite-null test
entry.scope: Independent fair arm choices and independent common stationary preparations; fixed sample count. Under the null both stages are reversible with the same pi. Count is Binomial(M,1/2).
entry.novelty_status: Standard randomization testing applied to the exact protocol-order identity.

entry.title: Robustness to preparation and generator calibration errors
entry.scope: Explicit total-variation preparation and rowwise transition-rate discrepancy bounds relative to common-reversible reference generators. These calibration bounds must be independently justified.
entry.novelty_status: Standard coupling and concentration tools; independently reviewed practical calibration extension.

entry.title: Rational finite-error certificate and cost-matched static comparison
entry.scope: At F magnitude 1/2, eta=4, t=1/5, s=2/5: 8829 independent records suffice for average equal-prior error below 0.1;12633 suffice for each error below 0.1. Sufficient counts, not minima. Switching, preparation, and calibration work excluded.
entry.novelty_status: Reproducible model certificate; no physical test or novel design optimizer.

entry.title: One-gateway hidden reversal survives exterior observation-based feedback
entry.scope: A hidden component shares its gateway sensor label; controls cannot change its internal transitions. Accessible-supported preparation or matched stationary preparation. Extra port, internal control, or refined sensor can escape.
entry.novelty_status: Operational use of established renewal and phase-type nonuniqueness.

entry.title: Four-state actuator placement separates static visibility and blindness
entry.scope: Specified four-ring seam model and balanced two-region detector. Crossing-edge reversible channel exposes an unequal-triple arrow; internal edge channel preserves full-law blindness.
entry.novelty_status: Relies in part on preserved baseline ring classification; exact construction priority unresolved.

entry.title: Six-state retained on/off sharp information crossover
entry.scope: Specified six-ring, common-stationarity control, fixed duration, small force and amplitude. Four readings/full path Theta(F^2 eta^2+F^4); three readings Theta(F^2 eta^2+F^6).
entry.novelty_status: Finite-model result, not a universal scaling law.

entry.title: Quantum central population instruments conceal reservoir-bias magnitude
entry.scope: Specified three-qubit XX Lindblad chain, stationary initial state. Five-dimensional observable closure covers arbitrary finite adaptive central Z/real-diagonal instruments.
entry.novelty_status: Specific classification priority unresolved; restricted quantum identification and driven XX models are established.

entry.title: Quantum magnitude activation and stronger sign obstruction
entry.scope: At g=gamma=1 two central X readings or Z-flip-Z reveal squared bias. All central-only operations remain sign-blind under outer reflection; unequal bonds break that symmetry. Measurements are invasive.
entry.novelty_status: No coherence necessity, quantum advantage, or physical time-reversal identification asserted.

entry.title: Persistence selection can produce only boundary asymmetry in a reversible killed model
entry.scope: State-dependent killing of finite reversible dynamics; stationary reference preparation yields reversible survivor paths. Quasi-stationary preparation yields endpoint likelihood ratio; Doob process reversible.
entry.novelty_status: Reversible Doob-transform result is established prior work. Endpoint illustration does not establish a new law.

entry.title: Computational optimizer novelty is not supported
entry.scope: Exact Bayesian information gain and symmetric KL choose the same schedules in the benchmark. A proposed weak-force heuristic can be inferior outside its local regime.
entry.novelty_status: Reject claim of new optimization superiority or recursive self-improvement.

entry.title: Universal physical law, universal data cap, P versus NP, and RSI claims
entry.scope: The proved finite-model statements do not establish these wider claims. Observation limits depend on hypothesis pair, target, preparation, interventions, measurement, and resources.
entry.novelty_status: No historical or empirical basis for those claims from this work.

entry.title: Explicit chemical free-energy realization and labelled-path KL identity
entry.scope: Three degenerate conformations, original fuel/waste reaction channels, and separate passive symmetric control channel. Mean drive free-energy dissipation E=M k_B T_b (t+s) 2F log((1+F)/(1-F)); labelled-path KL=E/(k_B T_b). Apparatus terms absent; literal bath heat needs additional thermochemistry.
entry.novelty_status: Application of established local detailed balance and likelihood identities; same-drive-dissipation access comparison is specific to the model.

entry.title: Heralded singleton preparation, exact null, and recovery expenditure
entry.scope: Exact noninvasive singleton detection, irreducible baseline, instantaneous control changes, fair arm choice after heralding. Common-reversible null holds from a detected state; regeneration gives independent fixed-duration trials. Nonstationary occupations and recovery included; startup and apparatus energy not fully modeled.
entry.novelty_status: Scoped implementation refinement using standard Markov regeneration; broader preparation access than the stationary-record comparison.

entry.title: Same-cap timing candidate with certified reduction in modeled drive expenditure
entry.scope: F magnitude 1/2, eta=4, t=127/1000, s=221/1000, M=9734. Rational certificate gives equal-prior average error below .1. Mean drive expenditure 3721.47442223 k_B T_b, 36.054819% below baseline;905 more preparations. Equal per-record apparatus term erases advantage above2.31857935443 k_B T_b.
entry.novelty_status: Standard numerical search followed by independent exact certification. No global optimum, new optimizer, total device-energy saving, or empirical measurement established.

entry.title: General edge-current correlation
entry.scope: Theorem for finite stationary Q, reversible autonomous R, and one pi-balanced added edge. Nonzero J times positive Dirichlet form is sufficient; no general converse.

entry.title: Triangle activation iff
entry.scope: Complete stationary singleton path distinguishes F from -F iff F != 0 and D_R(u)>0 in the specified triangle/reversible-gate class.

entry.title: Observation-dependent information orders
entry.scope: KL and squared Hellinger scale as F^2 eta^4 for hidden gate and F^2 eta^2 for retained gate, at fixed suitable finite horizon and regular positive-rate neighborhood.

entry.title: Calibrated finite-lag current interval
entry.scope: Requires known p,q,D and escape bound; Hoeffding and Bernstein coverage under stationary iid records. Bounds are impractically conservative in the example; no minimax or practical efficiency claim.

entry.title: Exact iid error certificates
entry.scope: Equal-prior average errors below .1 for stated fixed parameters and access; sufficient counts, not minima. Native-drive accounting excludes acquisition/preparation.

entry.title: Continuous-run error certificates
entry.scope: Conservative mixing-gap design, arbitrary initial hidden law after stated burn-in; no resets. Exact average-error bounds below .091, all native gap/burn-in drive counted.

entry.title: Zero added gate steady entropy production
entry.scope: Exact for specified local-detailed-balance channels and product stationarity. Preexisting drive remains. Not total sensing/apparatus expenditure.

entry.title: Thermal intermediate realization
entry.scope: Finite Markov embedding with positive profile and epsilon>0; exact controller autonomy, product law and zero gate/intermediate EP. No microscopic device identification.

entry.title: Perfect-bandwidth path nonconvergence
entry.scope: Brief intermediate return pulses supply nonvanishing distinguishing probability despite vanishing occupancy; fixed-grid convergence does not imply full-path TV convergence.

entry.title: Arbitrary-controller two-sensor-endpoint no-go
entry.scope: Triangle with scalar single-edge gating, common stationary preparation and independent finite controller, including driven controllers; not general networks or nonstationary launches.

entry.title: Matched-activity short-window clock coefficient
entry.scope: Leading retained-phase KL independent of ring-clock bias at fixed activity/profile; no global optimality at finite windows.

entry.title: Historical novelty of exact criterion
entry.scope: Focused primary-source searches do not establish priority. Correlation irreversibility/current inference and equilibrium kinetic trajectory information are established predecessors.

entry.title: New physical law or laboratory breakthrough
entry.scope: No empirical device measurements or independent external validation. Model theorems alone do not establish a physical law.
